name: HIWF World Championship
epitaph: Contested by tournament from the wing's own inaugural card in March 1997 -- a fifteen-man battle royal decided the first bye into the second round -- but no further round of the tournament survives in this collection's holdings, and no champion is ever crowned on the surviving record.
